implementations.name: pda
implementations.notes: Drives src/poppy directly (PoppyClient, sign-in, conversations, APIs, operations) in Node; no model.

implementations.name: lenient-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the lenient profile (interop/impls/pda-agent/profiles.ts): accepts every reading of what a Company does that gives no more access, such as server metadata at either S3 location and another of the Company's names as a client assertion aud after invalid_client. The reference agent for attribution rule 2. Sends what pda sends, so it may run in the live lane.

implementations.name: strict-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the strict profile: runs the runner's Company-side checks and the validator over everything it receives, refuses at the first finding of any level (a SHOULD or the Guides included), and serves its findings at GET /violations: in the live lane, which records nothing, the only checks a cell gets.

implementations.name: sloppy-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the sloppy profile: the mistakes real agents make, declared honestly: assertions without typ that live 300 s (S2 lenient-300s), a token-endpoint aud everywhere (S1 token-endpoint), scope on a signed-out Session request (S4 poppy-read). Honest, not adversarial. Never in the live lane ("live": false): its departures are deliberate.

implementations.name: lenient-company
implementations.notes: The mock Company from test/mock-company with its S2-lenient settings (strictAssertions off), the reference Company for attribution rule 2. Serves its recorded violations at GET /violations.

implementations.name: strict-company
implementations.notes: The same image as lenient-company with the mock's strict profile: assertion typ "JWT", a kid naming a published key and a 60-second lifetime (S2 jwt-60s), as the strictest live Companies require.

implementations.name: evil-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The adversarial Personal Agent: the pda-agent image with INTEROP_ADVERSARY=agent, armed with raw wire attacks (interop/impls/pda-agent/attacks.ts). Runs only against our own owner:self Companies, never in the live lane (docs/adversarial-interop.md; SECURITY.md).

implementations.name: evil-company
implementations.notes: The adversarial Company: the lenient-company image with INTEROP_ADVERSARY=company, reconfigured per attack by the arm hook. Runs only against our own owner:self agent, never in the live lane (docs/adversarial-interop.md; SECURITY.md).

implementations.name: pi-poppy

implementations.name: poppy-demo
implementations.notes: workers/caller under wrangler dev; the adapter drives CallerSession's protocol actions through /api/action, never the model. One Company per process.

implementations.name: poppy-demo
implementations.notes: Northstar (workers/receiver) under wrangler dev; patched to admit *.agent.interop.test client_ids (INTEROP_PEER_SUFFIX).

implementations.name: poppyseed
implementations.notes: Reference Company (fixtures/next-app) with its own test hooks; consent through its real pages.

implementations.name: ilmer
implementations.notes: Signed-out only; wrangler dev without Workers AI, so replies are a fixed apology.

implementations.name: print-with-poppy
implementations.notes: Agent-first photo-print store in APP_MODE=demo (payments, prints and email simulated); guest Sessions, OpenAPI and Operations v1, and accounts by an emailed code (Direct and Mediated Sign-In; the adapter reads the code demo mode stores); the grid's agents on its AGENT_CLIENT_IDS allowlist. Draft 0.2 only. Unpatched: ALLOW_COMPAT_AGENT_SESSIONS=false turns its non-Poppy Bearer path off, and upstream's ALLOW_INTEROP_TEST_HOSTS=true lets it fetch agents' metadata at private addresses for *.interop.test names only. MIT.

implementations.name: adonis-agora
implementations.notes: authkit-server 0.80.0 + @adonis-agora/agent 0.80.1 (Company conversations, agent commit e139b9599e61db17f85fa186f4073f81ee6bc19b) in a minimal AdonisJS host; scripted model; allowInsecureClientIds on for private-network peers.

implementations.name: adonis-agora
implementations.notes: Drives packages/adonis/src/poppy-client directly; no model.

implementations.name: everruns
implementations.notes: The poppy_client capability: worker_poppy_call (what its tools run) in everruns-server, in-memory mode, through its real egress service; no model. Signed-out only. Patches: RFC 1918 addresses pass the SSRF guard (interop setting, off by default); the signing key loader made public. MIT.

implementations.name: everruns
implementations.notes: A published poppy channel on everruns-server in in-memory mode, with a stand-in turn runner ("Reply N"); signed-out only. Patch: RFC 1918 addresses pass the SSRF guard (interop setting, off by default). MIT.

implementations.name: tipping-co
implementations.notes: packages/agent's CompanyClient driven directly, with packages/agent-host serving its client metadata; no model. Signed out, Direct Sign-In, OpenAPI. No licence declared: fetched at build, nothing kept.

implementations.name: tipping-co
implementations.notes: Tipping Co (packages/company, Hono, in-memory stores), signed out and Direct Sign-In, an OpenAPI API; the hooks sign in on its own pages. Relaxation: *.interop.test names pass its private-address check (INTEROP_ALLOW_TEST_HOSTS). No licence declared: fetched at build, nothing kept.

implementations.name: ilmer-live
implementations.notes: Live lane only: signed-out D, S0 and one or two C messages (a real model with a shared daily budget). Deployed commit not confirmed.

implementations.name: poppyseed-live
implementations.notes: Live lane only. On 11 October 2026 the apex 308-redirects to www., including POST /oauth/token, so S0 fails for agents that don't follow redirects with credentials. Deployed commit not confirmed.

implementations.name: alpine-retail-live
implementations.notes: Live lane only, with its developer's approval (13 October 2026): signed-out D, S0, N and C, with the live lane's public identity since 14 October; N reads inventory for a product code its own API lists. Declares 0.2 since at least 23 October. Its source isn't public, so no local adapter yet and no adversarial cells. Direct and Mediated (phone) sign-in, a Company Agent, and an OpenAPI API of three DPoP-protected GETs; no Operations.
